# Task 5: Violations Feed — Dashboard Report

## Status
**DONE**

## Commit
- **SHA:** `0282db8`
- **Branch:** `feat/dashboard-7b`
- **Message:** `feat(dashboard): violations feed (read-only list) — Refs PLAN 7.4`

## Summary
Successfully implemented the ViolationsPage component for the dashboard as a read-only violations feed.

## Changes Made
- **File modified:** `dashboard/src/violations/ViolationsPage.tsx`
  - Replaced 3-line placeholder with full implementation (67 insertions, 1 deletion)
  - Imports: `useEffect`, `useState` from React; API functions (`getViolations`, `getUsers`, `getZones`) from respective modules; type imports (`User`, `Zone`, `ZoneViolation`)
  - State management: `violations`, `reps`, `zones` arrays
  - Lifecycle: Calls `refresh()` on mount; `getUsers('rep')` and `getZones()` called in useEffect with empty dependency array
  - Refresh logic: `refresh()` function fetches violations on demand and on component mount; errors silently caught via `.catch(() => {})`
  - Lookups: Creates `Map` objects (`repEmailById`, `zoneNameById`) for efficient O(1) lookups of rep emails and zone names by ID
  - UI: Clean table layout with Tailwind styling
    - Header: Title + manual Refresh button (no auto-polling)
    - Columns: Rep (email), Zone (name), Detected (localized datetime), Status (Open/Resolved color-coded)
    - Empty state: "No violations recorded" message when violations array is empty
    - Row styling: Alternating borders for readability

## Verification Results
All verification commands succeeded:

```bash
$ npm run typecheck
> tsc -b
✓ TypeScript compilation with no errors

$ npm run build
> tsc -b && vite build
✓ Vite production build succeeded (478.41 kB → 143.50 kB gzipped)

$ npx vitest run
RUN  v4.1.10
Test Files: 2 passed (2)
Tests: 5 passed (5/5)
✓ All tests pass; no regression
```

## Design Notes
- Read-only feed: No create/edit/delete actions per spec (violations are rare backend events)
- Manual refresh instead of auto-polling: Consistent with backend design and similar rare-event patterns in this codebase
- Error handling: Silent failures (`.catch(() => {})`) prevent UI crashes; violations/reps/zones each degrade independently
- Fallback to IDs: If a rep or zone ID is not found in the lookup maps, the raw ID is displayed (defensive)
- Tailwind-first: No custom CSS, matches existing dashboard design system
